correctness.rationale: PASS. The specified icosahedral graph is a 12-vertex 30-edge planar 20-face triangulated sphere. Independent edge-by-edge enumeration of ordinary matchings yielded 5,887 nonempty faces with f-vector (30,315,1400,2535,1482,125). The full 23,130 face incidences and prescribed 2,866 discrete-Morse pairs form a directed acyclic graph (complete Kahn topological sort); critical cells are one vertex, 109 three-cells, 45 four-cells. Independent signed gradient-path recursion reconstructed the 109x45 Morse boundary: rank mod 3=44 and rank mod 2,5=45; specified exact 45x45 minor determinant +3. Since all maximal minors divisible by 3 and one equals 3, SNF=1^44,3; the 3-skeleton is bouquet of 109 S^3 and pi_3 is classified by integer degree vectors, so splitting yields 64 S^3 wedge M(Z/3,3). The torsion violates any wedge-of-spheres or contractible conclusion. Both integral exact certificate and complete incidence DAG are essential; modular Betti numbers alone would not prove the homotopy type.
